definitions.short: the multitude of Gog ; the fanciful name of an emblematic place in Palestine
definitions.full: the multitude of Gog ; the fanciful name of an emblematic place in Palestine

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘ “It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there; and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.
Those who pass through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.
